### A Prayer to Choose Life
Author: Tiffany Thibault
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-to-choose-life.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 30:19-20
Points:
- Each day presents a fundamental choice between life and blessing or death and curses.
- True life is not self-centered, but requires surrendering every part of oneself to God.
- Choosing life involves loving the Lord, listening closely to His voice, and holding fast to Him.
- Surrendering our lives to God's leadership extends spiritual blessings to our children.
- Daily habits of Bible reading and prayer strengthen trust in God during difficult seasons.
